lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sc₂MnCu crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Sc₈Mn₄Cu₄) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Cu and Mn center has eight Sc neighbors, while each Sc center has four Cu and four Mn neighbors, all adopting a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement with a uniform neighbor distance of 2.8099 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Sc–Sc 8-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Cu–Mn polyhedra share corners and faces.
